notes: Monoprix.fr (SFCC/Demandware, direct HTTP fetch worked, no WAF). Scope limited to the Maison (Home) department per assignment. Found genuine 'Nouveautes' (New Arrivals) taxonomy branch via sitemap_3-category.xml: parent https://www.monoprix.fr/c/nouveautes/maison plus 5 genuine site-defined children confirmed by each page's own breadcrumb label: Nouveautes Linge de Maison (Home Linens), Nouveautes Arts de la table (Tableware/Kitchen), Nouveautes Decoration (Decor), Nouveautes Salle de bain (Bathroom), Nouveautes Exterieur (Outdoor). All are real product-grid PLPs, not editorial/lookbook pages -- verified via each page's 'search-result-count' span (X resultats) and product-tile markup present (86 tile-markup hits on the parent page, consistent with real rendered products, matching the pattern also confirmed on the Outlet pages). Sum of the 5 children (104+136+104+12+18=374) is close to but not exactly equal to the parent's own reported total (390); this is normal -- the parent page's own header count was used verbatim for the parent row rather than derived by summing children, per the exact-qty-from-the-page-itself rule. Distinct from the 'tendances' (trends) taxonomy branch (e.g. /c/maison/tendances, /c/maison/tendances/nouvelle-collection) also found in the sitemap: 'tendances' pages are curated trend/style theme collections (e.g. 'nouvelle-collection', 'createurs' designer collabs, 'exclu-web'), not a recency-based 'newly added to catalogue' listing -- inspected and excluded as a different merchandising concept (curated trend collections, not New Arrivals) per brief Sec.3's Collection-page test; none of the tendances pages self-identify as a chronological/recency new-arrivals feed the way the dedicated Nouveautes branch does. No local-language absence concerns: 'Nouveautes' is the exact French equivalent target term and was found directly.
